column1: # Calls redirected to a static helper in org/kylepitcock/legacyconnector/v1_20_1/migrate (see Mc1201Migration).
# owner TAB name TAB descriptor TAB helper class TAB helper method [TAB helper descriptor]
# - A call on the owner or a subclass of it is rewritten unless a class of the mod declares the method on the way up (the mod's own method keeps its signature).
# - Without a helper descriptor: static helper taking the receiver first (instance calls) or returning the object (constructors: NEW/DUP/INVOKESPECIAL
#   becomes INVOKESTATIC). Descriptors and owners are in the 1.21.1 / Mojang names.
# - A descriptor ending in @special applies to INVOKESPECIAL only (super calls).
# - helper = "=" keeps the call but renames/re-describes it (helper method "-" keeps the name); "=swap" also swaps the last two arguments, "=pop" drops the
